timeline.summary: DCM Shriram International Limited announced the voting results and scrutinizer's report for its 4th Annual General Meeting held on July 16, 2026.
DCM Shriram International board ratified the payment of a Rs. 59,000 fine to the stock exchanges.
Suman Bansi Dhar filed for acquisition of a 3.46% stake in DCM Shriram International from Lala Bansi Dhar & Sons HUF via asset distribution.
DCM Shriram International announced a 30.92% inter-family promoter share transfer via gift and HUF dissolution, leaving total promoter holding unchanged at 50.11%.
Alok Bansidhar Shriram acquired a 30.92% stake in DCM Shriram International via an off-market inter-se promoter transfer on August 1, 2026.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹108.59 Cr, net profit ₹0.03 Cr.
